name: Boric Acid
problems: Consumer-style front label only: 'aqua science / 99.99% FINE POWDER / BORIC ACID / PURE ANHYDROUS 1 LB.' plus 'Manufactured by: Aqua Science, Inc, 1877 E 17th Avenue, Columbus, OH 43219'. No CAS, lot, catalog number or GHS panel was ever shown; the back of the bottle was never turned toward the camera. Fine-print warning text under the powder image is too small to read.

name: Quinizarin Green SS
problems: CAS 128-80-3 verified by checksum. Label also prints C28H22N2O2, MW=418.50. The GHS exclamation-mark pictogram sits on the right edge of the wrap-around label and is only partly visible; no signal word or H-codes were legible. No handwriting on this bottle.

name: Poly(methyl methacrylate)
problems: No CAS printed on the visible label. Lot recorded from 'PCode 1003856407, Source MKCZ2601' - the label calls MKCZ2601 the Source, not a Lot. The only handwriting is 'Avg Mv = 120 kDa' (a property note, not a received date), recorded in received_raw because there is no other handwriting field; there is no received date on this bottle. Label carries no GHS pictogram or signal word. CAS taken from the Sigma-Aldrich SDS for this product number, not from the label.

name: Isopropyl-9H-thioxanthen-9-one, mixture of 2- and 4-isomers

problems: CAS 75081-21-9 verified by checksum. Lot recorded from 'PCode 1003784741 / MKCS2137 Source'. No signal word or H-codes printed on the front panel; the two pictograms shown are the health-hazard and environment diamonds. Label also states 'Made in China'.

name: Poly(methyl methacrylate)
storage_note: For R&D use only. Not for drug, household, or other uses. SDS available.
problems: Second, distinct PMMA bottle (different catalog number and size from the 182230-25G bottle at 73-80 s). CAS 9011-14-7 verified by checksum. Label reads 'average Mw ~15,000 by GPC, powder' and 'Made in USA'. Lot recorded from 'MKCX5911 Source'; PCode 1003807908. No handwriting, no GHS pictogram or signal word.

name: SOLESPHERE NP-30
problems: Front label gives brand RESIFA, product SOLESPHERE NP-30 Series, Lot No. 262T3K724, NET 100 g, AGC Si-Tech Co., Ltd., Wakamatsu-ku Kitakyushu, Fukuoka 808-0027 Japan. No CAS or catalog number printed. A Japanese/English hazard panel (a 'WARNING'-style block) runs down the right side of the bottle but was never turned toward the camera and is not legible at any frame, so signal word, pictograms and H-codes are left blank. Second handwritten note reads '~2 um dia' (the unit glyph is ambiguous, possibly 'nm'); it is a size note, not a nickname.

name: Treated Colloidal Silica TPX-5075
storage_note: Keep away from all ignition sources including heat, sparks and flame. Prevent dust accumulations to minimize explosion hazard.
problems: Sample bottle with a printed sample label: 'Product name: Treated Colloidal Silica TPX-5075 / Product Code: TPX5075 / Sample ID: 3692110'. Lot field holds the Sample ID (no lot number is printed). Label explicitly states 'Pictogram: None' and 'Signal Word: WARNING'; GHS hazard statement text is 'May form combustible dust concentrations in air' (no H-code numbers printed). No net weight or CAS anywhere on the label, so size/unit are blank. Address: 157 Concord Road, Billerica, MA 01821.

name: Polystyrene-block-poly(ethylene-ran-butylene)-block-polystyrene
storage_note: For R&D use only. Not for drug, household, or other uses.
problems: Label reads 'powder, average Mw ~118,000 by GPC, contains >0.03% antioxidant as inhibitor'. No CAS printed on the portion of the label ever shown. Lot recorded from 'MKCZ7714 Source'. The handwritten nickname is 'PSTMA' as written (it does not obviously match the printed polymer name, so it may be a lab shorthand). The left-hand column of fine print and any GHS panel were never rotated toward the camera, so signal word and pictograms are blank. CAS taken from the Sigma-Aldrich SDS for this product number, not from the label.

name: Lubrizol Sample AG8451
problems: Plastic sample bag inside a clear overbag, sitting in a yellow bin; the camera pans over it (109-110 s and 113-116 s) and the gloved hand moves the bags, but it is never lifted and turned the way the bottles are. The ONLY printed text is the two-line label 'Lubrizol Sample / AG8451'. No chemical name, CAS, size, lot, date or hazard information anywhere. AG8451 recorded as catalog_no because it is the only identifier. May be the same physical bag as the 'Pearlbond 960' entry (110-113 s) seen from another side - frames at 115 s show two separate bags in the bin, which is why both are reported, but I could not fully rule out a single bag with two labels.

name: Lubrizol Sample Pearlbond 960
problems: Flat plastic sample bag in the same yellow bin; the gloved hand rests on / moves it but never lifts it toward the camera. The ONLY printed text is 'Lubrizol Sample / Pearlbond 960'. No chemical name, CAS, size, lot, date or hazard information. See the AG8451 entry: these may be two bags or one bag with two labels.
